sentence: This project studies how biocrusts and plants together shape patterns in drylands and how those patterns change with rainfall.
This project studies early mammal communities from the Age of Dinosaurs by building 3D models of fossil dentition.
This project builds mathematical and computational tools that learn the rules governing complex systems from snapshots of many systems.
This project sets up a summer program that teaches artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, drone technology and the Internet of Things.
This project builds formal privacy models that prevent specific attacks on data when standard methods make results much less useful.
This project develops smart technologies for buildings that make energy use more efficient and sustainable.
This project studies why the time deep neural networks need varies in autonomous vehicles and builds a framework to make it predictable.
This project develops machine learning and statistical methods to predict from network data and to compare groups of networks, such as brain connectivity networks.
This project studies how droughts and other climate extremes keep affecting tree growth and carbon in western US drylands long afterward.
This project studies whether a control architecture that adds outside metrology systems to robots can make robots more accurate.
This project studies how the composition of electrolytes changes their structure and how well rechargeable batteries work.
This project builds coding exercises and virtual workshops that teach computational skills for biochemistry and molecular biology.
This project studies how small changes in temperature affect which genetic changes help yeast adapt over time.
This project builds an artificial intelligence model that combines soil microbiome data from many studies to link soil microbes to carbon storage.
This project designs algorithms and uses them on hands-on problems in computational biology and cybersecurity.
This project studies systems of many interacting particles by combining differential-equation analysis with data science tools to infer unknown parameters.
This project sets up a system that combines Raman technology with scanning probe microscopy to study the properties of nanomaterials.
